setlist.title: Baby, What You Want Me To Do?

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Baby, What You Want Me To Do?** (3 reviews): Reviewer links this song to a scene from Cheech and Chong's Next Movie; Reviewer notes Brent sang this only a few times [30][35][39]
- **Revolution** (2 reviews): Opens second set with a nice groove, though Jerry mangles the lyrics; Reviewer calls it disastrous, saying Bobby and Jerry sound as if they drank heavily between sets [32][33]
- **(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction** (2 reviews): Phil's bass bombs during Satisfaction are unforgettable; reviewer says that track alone justifies the download; The crowd audibly eggs Bob on during Satisfaction [30][38]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Brown Eyed Women hot, within a generally good first set [33]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Phil takes over the lead in Jack Straw, to the reviewer's delight [34]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Very tight playing among drummers, Phil and Jerry; Healy delays Bobby's screams, followed by a great instrumental jam at the end [32]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the worst Eyes they have ever heard, unlistenable [32]
- **She Belongs To Me** (1 review): Reviewer finds this version absolutely precious [35]

## Setlist highlights

- **Baby, What You Want Me To Do?**: rare: 5 archived performances [42]
- **It's nobody's birthday**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **Revolution**: rare: 12 archived performances [42]
- **She Belongs To Me**: rare: 10 archived performances [42]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-08.152021.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 127 min [1]
- **gd1985-11-08.149436.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 132 min [3]
- **gd1985-11-08.akg.andrewf.86547.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 128 min [5]
- **gd1985-11-08.139899.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 133 min [6]
- **gd85-11-08.aud-oade.dwonk.22023.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 133 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [12]. Said about its sound: Reviewer considers this a very good audience recording, giving it a strong four stars for quality [40]
- **gd85-11-08.sbd.clugston.5301.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 123 min; rated 3.88/5 by 17 [23]. Said about its sound: Tape cuts out and fades between channels at times; recommended only for those who attended [33]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls the venue as a smaller building, which they liked [30]
- Reviewer's first Dead show; found the crowd amazing to watch and the night special [31]
- Reviewer flew in and arrived during the start of Iko Iko; a fan from Jersey shouted for Jerry behind them [41]
- A huge Blues For Allah banner was unrolled during the Satisfaction encore [41]
- Reviewer says this was their last show of the 1985 tour [41]
- This was the Dead's final performance at the War Memorial [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-08.152021.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes (Taper's Section); Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [1]
- **gd1985-11-08.149436.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Hunt and Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Rob Hunt and Ted Mattes' Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [3]
- **gd1985-11-08.akg.andrewf.86547.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F and Jim Wise; source: AKG CK1's > Uher CR-240 > Sony TC-D5M (first deck out). Taped onto Maxell MX-90's with no Dolby. Mics on stand (aprx 7 feet) set up just to the left (stage… [5]. Also: AKG-based source patched with four small pieces from ShnID-22023, including Bobby's set intros and a bit of Little Red Rooster [5]
- **gd1985-11-08.139899.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [6]. Also: Soundboard-based fileset in 16 bit, with patch source supplied by the Oade Brothers [6]
- **gd85-11-08.aud-oade.dwonk.22023.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Oade Brothers; source: Audience Recording [12]
- **gd85-11-08.sbd.clugston.5301.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR, with patches from Charlie Connor's Master Audience Cassette (Beyer M88 mics> Sony TC-D5M in d1t7,8 [23]
